title: Meta ads, 2026 lifetime per ad
description: One row per Meta ad with spend in Taiwan or Hong Kong since 2026-01-01: lifetime totals in its dominant market plus the trailing 7 days.

args.query:
WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`),
f AS (
  SELECT f.ad_id, f.ad_name, f.country, f.os, f.campaign_name, f.date, f.spend, f.impressions, f.clicks, f.installs, f.trial_starts, f.initial_purchases, f.checkouts_initiated, f.n_3_sec_video_views, f.ad_preview_link
  FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel` f
  WHERE f.date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND f.country IN ('Taiwan','Hong Kong') AND f.spend > 0
),
mkt AS (
  SELECT ad_id, country FROM f GROUP BY ad_id, country
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id ORDER BY SUM(spend) DESC, country) = 1
)
SELECT f.ad_id,
  ANY_VALUE(f.ad_name) AS ad_name,
  m.country AS market,
  ANY_VALUE(f.campaign_name HAVING MAX f.spend) AS top_campaign,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT f.os ORDER BY f.os) AS os_mix,
  MIN(f.date) AS first_spend_date,
  MAX(f.date) AS last_spend_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.date) AS active_days,
  ROUND(SUM(f.spend),2) AS spend,
  SUM(f.impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(f.clicks) AS clicks,
  SUM(f.installs) AS installs,
  SUM(f.checkouts_initiated) AS checkouts,
  SUM(f.trial_starts) AS trial_starts,
  SUM(f.initial_purchases) AS purchases,
  SUM(f.n_3_sec_video_views) AS views_3s,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(f.date > DATE_SUB(a.max_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY), f.spend, 0)),2) AS spend_7d,
  SUM(IF(f.date > DATE_SUB(a.max_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY), f.trial_starts, 0)) AS trial_starts_7d,
  ANY_VALUE(f.ad_preview_link) AS preview_link,
  a.max_date AS data_through
FROM f JOIN mkt m ON m.ad_id = f.ad_id AND m.country = f.country
CROSS JOIN anchor a
GROUP BY f.ad_id, m.country, a.max_date
ORDER BY spend DESC
